sd_1_5.description: Stable Diffusion 1.5, used in the original paper (Cheng et al. 2025). CLIP text encoder: prompts are cut off after 77 tokens.

settings_source.torch_dtype: Hard-coded in server.py of the original repo (Cheng et al. 2025): DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(..., torch_dtype=torch.float16).
settings_source.generation: Not set in the original repo (pipeline(text) without arguments), so the defaults of diffusers' StableDiffusionPipeline.__call__ applied: num_inference_steps=50, guidance_scale=7.5 (checked in diffusers 0.32.2).

sd_3_5_medium.description: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium (2.5B, MMDiT-X). Text encoders: CLIP-L and CLIP-G (77 tokens) plus T5-XXL (up to max_sequence_length tokens), so long prompts are not cut off at 77 tokens. Gated: needs a Hugging Face login and accepting the Stability AI Community License on the model page.

settings_source.generation: num_inference_steps=40 and guidance_scale=4.5 from the model card example (the diffusers defaults would be 28 and 7.0). max_sequence_length=256 is the default of StableDiffusion3Pipeline in diffusers 0.32.2; the model card warns of artifacts above 256 T5 tokens.

gemma2_2b.description: Gemma 2 2B via Ollama, used in the original paper (Cheng et al. 2025) for both the gate and the story step.

moondream2_2024_07_23.description: moondream2 at the revision pinned in the original paper (Cheng et al. 2025).

cheng2025_baseline.description: Model combination of the original paper and repo (Cheng et al. 2025). Use it to reproduce the paper.

cheng2025_baseline_no_story.description: Models of cheng2025_baseline without the story step: the user prompt (plus enforcement clause) goes directly to the image model. Measures the image model's bias without the LLM rewriting it.

cheng2025_with_sd_3_5_medium.description: Models of cheng2025_baseline with Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium instead of 1.5 as the image model. Measures the effect of a newer image model with the story step.

cheng2025_with_sd_3_5_medium_no_story.description: cheng2025_with_sd_3_5_medium without the story step: the user prompt (plus enforcement clause) goes directly to Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium. Measures its bias without the LLM rewriting the prompt.

gender_machinery_occupations.conditioned_value: a person working in a machine or vehicle engineering occupation (e.g., car mechatronics technician, industrial mechanic)

reference.source: Bundesagentur für Arbeit, Beschäftigungsstatistik, Beschäftigte nach Berufen (KldB 2010), Deutschland; KldB 25 Maschinen- und Fahrzeugtechnikberufe; sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschäftigte, Tabellen 1/1.1/1.2; Stichtag März 2026

gender_cleaning_occupations.conditioned_value: a person working in a cleaning occupation (e.g., office cleaner, building cleaner)

reference.source: Bundesagentur für Arbeit, Beschäftigungsstatistik, Beschäftigte nach Berufen (KldB 2010), Deutschland; KldB 54 Reinigungsberufe; geringfügig Beschäftigte, Tabellen 3/3.1/3.2; Stichtag März 2026
